sites.name: LACC Food Pantry (Food for Thought)
sites.address: 855 N Vermont Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90029

schedules.note: Weekly Thursday distribution at/outside the Student Union; exact hours vary by term (sources cite Thu ~11:00-14:00 and also a Wed/Thu 10:00-12:00 & 12:30-15:00 window). Students only, Student ID + bag required.

sites.note: Confirmed active student pantry on LACC main campus, Student Union 1st floor. Day (Thursday) consistent across sources but exact times conflict; could not load the primary page directly (HTTP 403) to pin current-term hours.

sites.name: Los Angeles Mission
sites.note: Active Skid Row meal provider. Public meal serving times confirmed: breakfast Mon-Sat 5:30am (first 100), lunch Mon-Sat 12:30pm, dinner Mon-Sat 6:30pm; all meals to-go, first come first served. Phone 213-629-1227 confirmed on operator homepage.

sites.name: Hollywood Sikh Temple (Gurdwara Vermont) Langar
sites.address: 1966 N Vermont Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90027

schedules.note: Langar (free community meal) served following the Sunday service, which begins 10:00am; approximate 11:00-13:00 window.

sites.note: Temple active; free langar is open to all after services. Operator page confirms Sunday service 10:00am onward and evening services 6:30pm, each followed by langar, but does not publish exact langar start/end times. Sunday ~11:00-13:00 is approximate; weekday/Friday langar times not confirmed.

sites.name: King Fahad Mosque Food Program
sites.note: Mosque is active at this address (phone corrected to 310-202-0432 from operator site). Could NOT confirm any food bank/food distribution program: the mosque's own website lists no food program, and the cited CAIR 'Muslim-run food banks' page does not list King Fahad Mosque. The Sat 7:30-10:30 schedule in the input is unverified by any primary source.

sites.name: El Centro de Ayuda Food Distribution
sites.address: 2130 E 1st St, Suite 110, Los Angeles, CA 90033

schedules.note: Food distributed to LA City residents on Mon and Wed starting ~11:30am until supplies last; registration + proof of address/income required.

sites.note: Boyle Heights FamilySource / El Centro de Ayuda active. Distribution Mon & Wed from 11:30am (input listed Mon only; Wed added from source). Phone and address confirmed; close time approximate (until supplies last).
